units.name: B10RunCoordinatedUpperResponse
units.summary: While palette control is nonnegative, a zero slot value tests its palette bit and latches it if absent; nonzero slot values decrement, move horizontally1 and start timer8 for slots0/1 or4 for slots2/3. With negative palette control, a set slot-mask test flips direction bit2; a nonzero facing test flips bits1/2. Refresh response bits5/6 from the packed slot classes, store slot value19, and select response19 for class60 or response4 otherwise.

units.name: B10RebuildCoordinatedSlotClasses
units.summary: Sum the two shared counters. Zero clears the packed byte94. For totals1/2 the code loads Y with60/40 but stores A (the count) to byte94; the unused Y values do not change the result. For totals3/4 compare actor X with player X. At or right of the player, preserve byte94 bits2/3/6/7 and set bits4/5, also bits0/1 for total4. Left of the player, preserve bits0/1/4/5 and set bits2/3/6/7; for total3 reduce this to preserved bits2..5 plus bit7. The byte subsequently supplies four packed two-bit slot classes. Exact selection policy remains uncertain; the literal stores are preserved.

units.name: B10TestCoordinatedSlotPaletteBit
units.summary: Return palette-control AND (1 shifted by the low two slot-class bits). Preserves X; Y is the shift counter. Only the selected bit contributes to Z.

units.name: B10LatchCoordinatedSlotPaletteBit
units.summary: OR the bit selected by low two slot-class bits into palette control. Preserves X and leaves the updated control byte in A.

units.name: B10CompareCoordinatedActorPlayerX
units.summary: Compare actor and player unsigned16-bit X coordinates, high byte first and low byte only on equality. C reports actor X at least player X; no coordinates change.

units.name: B10ReadCoordinatedSlotClass
units.summary: Extract a two-bit field from packed byte94 and return it in response-bit positions5/6. Low two slot-class bits choose the field, from high pair for slot0 through low pair for slot3. Preserve Y on the stack; scratch F6 receives the result. The rotate/shift loop retains the original carry behavior.

units.name: B10BeginCoordinatedHealthWindow
units.summary: Keep response high bits but select low response2; write state BB and reset motion phase. Set direction-class high bits to80 and start timer125. Used both at coordinated initialization and when the health-window gate restarts.

units.name: B10TestCoordinatedHealthWindow
units.summary: Upper response classes return their nonzero masked value. For class zero, return1 only when shape-radius is not3 and unsigned (saved health minus current health) is less than5. Otherwise save current health, restart the BB health window and return0. Subtraction wraps as an eight-bit value; this is not an absolute difference.

units.name: B10CloneCoordinatedSlot
units.summary: Preserve caller X, allocate a slot and stop on failure. Save the new slot timer flags, then copy15 bytes from the current actor beginning at response flags, restoring the new slot timer flags afterward. Set its slot index from shared auxiliary97, clear its upper response class and OR the packed class for that slot. Set state BC and health4; set direction bit2, then toggle it for odd slot indices. Record the new slot in the shared counters and increment auxiliary97. The caller retains its actor X; allocation helper supplies the new X and current source offset F1.

Reset motion phase, preserve response high bits, disable both contact shapes, clear path-finished and update facing/terrain through fixed C108. If update bit3 is set, select path1. C108 updates facing/terrain.

With multiple slots, count class1 then class2 and request replacement when the selected class count is zero. Finally change actor type to B0, award the actor counter, clear its record and timer-started flag. Counter decrements are unsaturated; slot counts and packed fields must agree on entry.

units.name: B10CountCoordinatedPackedClass

units.name: B11ActorEntryVeneers

units.name: B11TickDelayedSoundLatch
units.summary: Shared byte$A0 combines a low7-bit tick count with a bit7 sound latch. While bit7 is clear, increment the full byte once per call. While set, wait until the low count reaches10, then queue sound11, preserving X, and replace the byte with$80. This prevents another sound until the state dispatcher clears bit7; it is not an actor-private timer. Counts below10 also increment while latched.

units.name: B11DispatchActorState
units.summary: Restore current actor X and route states64/6C/63/68 through the delayed sound tick. States69/6A clear the sound latch and share a handler; state6E clears it and uses completion/contact handling. Other states clear actor and timer-start. Recognized handlers return through shared coordinate computation; gameplay identities of the states remain unresolved.

units.name: B11FinishDispatchedActorState

units.name: B11TickState64ContactGate
units.summary: Consume contact for the current actor. Absence clears update bit3 and enters state6E completion. Otherwise ensure the companion actor exists, then enter state64 selection only when the actor timer is idle. Companion creation is gated by shared control bit6.

units.name: B11SelectState64MotionMode
units.summary: Decode movement. Mode4 or a nonzero depth-region test selects primary/secondary parameters1/0; ordinary initialization selects0/1. Both clear alternate-slot motion and update bits0/5/7 before state6C. Slot bit7 instead advances the six-step path: zero decodes movement6, nonzero movement4. Other slots orient toward player X, copy direction into shared control and compare player depth before packed-phase selection.

units.name: B11SelectState64NearResponse
units.summary: Test range/facing at32, falling back to the40-unit range stage on failure. Success sets shared control bit3. Global flag5 selects the packed low2 field or bits2..3, which cycle through their response choices. Choices select state68, state63, state6A or the mode4 path through the named setup helpers. The low-field phase3 first moves horizontally16 and decodes movement6. Packed fields are established per-actor phases; their gameplay meaning remains unresolved.

units.name: B11SelectState64FarResponse
units.summary: Test range/facing at40; failure uses the default six-unit horizontal step. Success clears shared control bit3. Global flag5 selects packed bits4..5 or6..7; each cycles through four phases. Named state/control setters, slot classes and distance initialization configure each path. Some phases reset motion and decode movement6; high-field phase2 reuses middle-field phase2. Other packed bits are preserved.

units.name: B11AdvanceState64Motion
units.summary: The ordinary entry supplies a6-unit horizontal step; the near-response phase3 entry supplies$10. Increment motion phase and read its next byte. A nonzero byte decodes movement mode6; a zero byte first clears motion phase. The separate mode4 entry decodes4 without resetting the phase. All paths return to the state dispatcher, which then runs its shared finish helper.

units.name: B11BeginOrTickState6E
units.summary: Return when the completion latch is set. On first entry set state6E, clear motion, preserve shared control bits3..6 and select low value6. Disable both contact shapes, update facing/terrain and refresh the HUD for type28. Update bit3 chooses fixed C1E3 with A1 and a five-frame wait; otherwise wait thirty frames. Finish the slot six-step path after starting the timer. Later entries continue only when the timer is idle.

units.name: B11TickState6ELiveResponse
units.summary: Wait for the timer. Update bit3 with a nonnegative signed C1C2 result selects retiming; zero health selects completion. Live actors clear update bits5/7, select state64/control1 and clear shared control bit6. A facing result can toggle direction bits1..2 before copying direction into shared control. Cycle slot low3 bits through1,2,3,4,0. Named state/control and class setters configure each path. Phase3 arms a24-unit six-step path, conditionally reselects state64 when update bit1 is clear, advances that path and starts a four-frame timer. Other phases use the named state69/6A or state6C handlers.

units.name: B11RetimeState6EResponse

units.name: B11TickState6ECompletion

At termination award the actor counter, clear shared control bits6/7 and mark completion by clearing the stage/shape active flags and setting response bit0. Type28 retains the actor, backs up one phase and clears timer-start. Other types replace completion-selector low nibble with6, clear actor and timer-start. The selector gameplay meaning remains unresolved.

units.name: B11TickState6C

With negative signed C1C2, an alternate-motion slot flag forces state6E/reset phase. Otherwise slot class bits4..5 select:0/3 toggle direction bit2 and resume state64;1 starts the state68 ten-frame path;2 starts the state6A thirty-frame path. These clear update bits5/7 and toggle direction bit1 before their named setup. With nonnegative signed result, run C1DD and advance/reset motion only while the alternate-motion flag is clear, then wait five frames. The signed fixed predicate gameplay role remains unresolved.

units.name: B11TickState71EightFramePath
units.summary: Absent contact clears update flag3, sets the slot completion variant and enters state72/74 completion. Active idle updates advance motion; termination selects state6F with mode and resumes selection, while other bytes wait eight frames.

units.name: B11GateState76FamilyActivation
units.summary: Use response bit3 as an activation latch. Before activation, camera X must be zero and the sequence phase must equal3; otherwise disable both contact shapes. When the gate opens enable both contact shapes, latch activation and dispatch the family.

units.name: B11DispatchState76Family
units.summary: Dispatch states76,77,7A,79 and7C to local handlers. Clear unmatched actors and their timer-start flag. All valid cases share the final return.

units.name: B11TickState76Detour
units.summary: Wait for the actor timer. On first update double measured player distance into the secondary parameter and set response bit5; doubling uses byte arithmetic. While distance remains and the forward probe returns0, step horizontally6, advance/reset motion, saturate remaining distance at0 and wait six frames. Exhaustion or probe result1 (collision low3 bits clear) toggles direction bits1..2, clears response bits5..6 and re-enters state76 selection. The probe condition is preserved literally without assigning obstacle meaning.

units.name: B11TickState76ContactGate
units.summary: Response bit6 delegates to the detour. Otherwise consume contact; absence clears update flag3 and enters state7C completion. Active actors wait for the timer. Slot bit7 selects a forward probe. Result1 (collision low3 bits clear) toggles direction bit2, clears slot bits6..7, latches the detour and runs it. Result0 advances the shared six-step path and chooses six or eight frames. Other slots continue into position-based selection.

units.name: B11SelectState76AtPlayerY
units.summary: Compare full actor/player Y; unequal Y uses the separate branch. At equal Y, facing/range can toggle direction or select state7A. The near path sets packed interval bit2, clears bit6 and clears the interval active latch when bit2 was previously clear. Wait eight frames while the interval is busy; otherwise start70 frames and advance the low2 phase field. Choices select state77 or arm a16-unit six-step path. Packed bit3 from state7A suppresses a repeated direction toggle once.

units.name: B11SelectState76AtOtherY
units.summary: Require boundary Y low to match player Y low or wait eight frames. Adjust direction from facing/range. When packed bit6 is clear, set it, clear bit2 and clear the shared interval latch. Wait eight frames while the interval is busy; otherwise start125 frames. Rotate packed bits4..5 through three projectile-pattern variants and enter state79.

units.name: B11AdvanceState76FreeMotion
units.summary: Forward probe result1 (collision low3 bits clear) toggles direction bits1..2, latches the detour and runs it. Result0 applies horizontal step6, advances/resets motion and waits eight frames. These exact predicate conditions do not establish an obstacle interpretation.

units.name: B11ProbeState7CCompletionSide
units.summary: Copy actor coordinates into the collision probe and offset X by8 on the side chosen by the signed actor/player X comparison. Store that side in response bit4. A zero collision result latches detour bit6 and sets or clears direction bits1..2 consistently, returning0; a nonzero result returns unchanged. The probe therefore supplies both a predicate and direction preparation.

units.name: B11TickState7CCompletion
units.summary: The response-bit0 completion latch can return immediately. On entering state7C reset motion, disable both contact shapes and probe a side; a nonzero probe invokes probe-limited displacement. Refresh the HUD, finish active slot-path flags and wait thirty frames. Later live actors select state76 again. Dead actors advance motion until termination, award the counter, mark completion, undo the final phase increment and clear timer-start.

units.name: B11TickState77TwentyFramePath
units.summary: Absent contact clears update flag3 and enters state7C completion. Active idle updates increment motion; zero selects state76 and resumes its handler, while nonzero waits twenty frames.

units.name: B11TickState7ATwentyFramePath
units.summary: Like the state77 path, but a zero motion byte sets packed bit3 before selecting state76. Nonzero motion waits twenty frames; absent contact enters state7C completion.

units.name: B11TickState79TwentyFramePath
units.summary: Absent contact enters state7C completion. Active idle updates increment motion, select and run state76 on termination, and otherwise wait twenty frames.

units.name: B11EmitState79Pattern
units.summary: Measure player distance into scratch F3. Packed bits4..5 select three, two or one spawn calls with different offset pairs. Restore current actor X, select state79, reload shapes and run its timed path. Each spawn may independently fail allocation.

units.name: B11EmitPatternPositiveOffset
units.summary: Set spawn adjustment12 and vertical offset48, then call the shared allocator.

units.name: B11EmitPatternZeroOffset
units.summary: Set spawn adjustment0 and vertical offset48, then call the shared allocator.

units.name: B11EmitPatternNegativeOffset
units.summary: Set encoded negative adjustment12 (bit7 plus12) and vertical offset0, then call the shared allocator.

units.name: B11AllocateStateC4PatternActor
units.summary: Attempt allocation, restoring source X on failure. Initialize the new stateC4 actor and its relative coordinates, then fold the distance and encoded signed adjustment around16 to select direction. Compute adjusted vertical separation plus16. Divide components by8 and by the resulting major-component quotient to store remainders and per-step components in fields36..39. The two branches exchange horizontal/vertical roles; zero horizontal distance explicitly supplies quotient0. This is a component ratio construction, with byte arithmetic preserved. Return with the source actor selected.

units.name: B11LimitHorizontalStepByProbe
units.summary: Input A is the requested horizontal step. Build a collision probe that far left or right from the actor using direction bit2. If the subtraction borrows, the literal branch falls through the alternate addition calculation; preserve that behavior. Probe collision and return the requested step when nonzero, or0 when clear. Preserve the request through the fixed probe call.

units.name: B11DisplaceActorFromPlayerSide
units.summary: Encode facing; a negative result returns. Otherwise request a probe-limited horizontal step equal to shape radius times8. For one encoded side temporarily toggle direction bit2 before moving, then restore it. The other side moves directly.

units.name: B11DispatchPatternActorState
units.summary: Dispatch spawned pattern statesC4 andC5. Clear other actors and their timer-start flag.

units.name: B11TickPatternActorFlight
units.summary: Direction/contact bits4..5 select the contact exit. Otherwise wait for the timer, consume one-shot remainders in fields36/37 by adding them to base steps38/39, move horizontally and step Y through the directional helper. Both viewport-margin predicates must pass. At the low-byte Y boundary clamp Y, enter stateC5 and run its terminal path; otherwise advance/reset motion and wait six frames. Margin failure clears actor/timer. The Y-step helper subtracts A when direction bit 3 is set and adds otherwise, retaining the coordinate change; its asymmetric X/Y-limit return value is ignored here in favor of the explicit margin and boundary tests.

units.name: B11RemovePatternActorOnContact
units.summary: Queue sound0D only when direction/contact bit5 is set, preserving X, then clear actor and timer-start flag.

units.name: B11TickPatternActorTerminalMotion
units.summary: Wait for timer, advance motion and remove the actor at a zero byte. Nonzero motion starts a fifteen-frame timer.

units.name: B11MeasureActorPlayerYLowDistance
units.summary: Choose subtraction direction from the full actor/player Y comparison and return the low byte of the absolute difference. Higher-byte magnitude is discarded.

units.name: B11OrientActorTowardPlayerX
units.summary: Compare signed actor X high byte and then full actor/player X. Set direction bits1..2 when actor X is greater; clear both when less or negative. Equality preserves the existing bits.

units.name: B11ToggleActorDirectionBitOne

regions.summary: Phase0 writes tile bytes until the full-count or per-pass count is reached. A partial pass retains cursor and advances the PPU address low byte by1. At full count, bit6 requests attributes: choose phase1 when $39 is nonzero, otherwise phase2. Without attributes, clear cursor/phase and request bit0. Phase1 writes four attribute bytes at addresses spaced8 apart, then resumes phase2. Phase2 starts at the saved cursor, writes through the supplied count, and clears phase/cursor, attribute bit6 and video request bit0. Address-low addition deliberately has no carry into the high byte. Counts must be valid.

regions.summary: Build path displacement from actor/player X distance. Set class bits 1/2 together when actor X is at or beyond player X, clear them otherwise. Selector bit 0 chooses a bias of 88 or 44 and reverses which side adds it. Clamp subtraction below zero and any positive high byte to 0..255, divide by 14 and clear update bit 0. Additional entries use (distance+32)/10 with bit 0 set, copy parameter $97 with bit 0 clear, or use (2*distance)/12 with bit 0 clear. Arithmetic is unsigned except for the explicit negative-high clamp.
